title: Turning Time Clock off through the API turns Technician off
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Have a valid Public API key for the test organization, the Public API documentation for staff, and a request tool (Postman or any tool that sends requests with that key).
  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Parts Manager role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only, leading no work.
  • Note staff member A's id as the Public API gives it (from GET /api/v1/staff).
custom_steps:
1. Send PATCH /api/v1/staff/<staff member A's id> with the API key, turning Time Clock off.
  2. Send GET /api/v1/staff/<staff member A's id> with the API key.
  3. Open staff member A's Edit Staff Member window in the app.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The update succeeds: it is not refused.

Step 2:

  • The record shows Time Clock off and "technician": false.

Step 3:

  • Time Clock is off.
  • Technician is off and grayed out.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11879 (Story 1, Technician toggle on a staff member)

  • S1-R4: “Technician can only be on while Time Clock is on. While Time Clock is off, the Technician toggle is off and grayed out, and hovering it shows "Turn on Time Clock first. Only staff who clock in can be technicians." Turning Time Clock off, in the window or any other way (for example through the Public API), turns Technician off.”
  • Story 1, Error Handling: “The window never sends Technician on without Time Clock, or for a staff member on the built-in Office User or Time Clock User role. A request from elsewhere (for example an outside tool) that would switch Technician from off to on in either case is refused with "A technician must have Time Clock on." or "This role can't be a technician." respectively, shown through the existing request error behavior, and nothing is saved. When both apply (Time Clock off and one of those roles), the message is "This role can't be a technician.", both on hover in the window and in the refusal. A request for a staff member whose Technician is already on that turns Time Clock off, or moves them to one of those roles, is not refused: it saves, and Technician turns off (S1-R4, S1-N1).”
